app.name: Virasat
app.tagline: Family recipes, in the voices of the people who made them.

landing.headline: Keep the recipes that live in their hands
landing.body: Record Ba telling her recipe in her own words. Keep her voice, her handwriting and her stories, and pass them down.

signIn.title: Sign in or create an account
signIn.subtitle: We'll send you a code. There's no password to remember.
signIn.phoneHint: Include your country code, like +91 or +44.
signIn.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link and a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Tap the link, or enter the code here.
signIn.startOver: Use a different email or number
signIn.privacy: Your family's recipes stay private unless you choose to share them.
signIn.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new code.
signIn.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
signIn.sendFailed: We couldn't send a code. Check the details and try again.
signIn.smsFailed: We couldn't send a text to that number. Check it, or sign in with email instead.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

onboarding.title: Name your family vault
onboarding.body: This is where your family's recipes, voices and stories will live. Most families use their surname.

vault.peopleEmptyTitle: Add the people whose recipes you want to keep
vault.peopleEmptyBody: Start with someone who cooks from memory. They don't need an account.

roles.ownerHelp: Can do everything, including managing owners.
roles.adminHelp: Can invite family and manage people.
roles.memberHelp: Can add and edit people and recipes.
roles.viewerHelp: Can look, but can't change anything.

person.nameHint: Their full name, as you'd write it.
person.relationHint: Like Ba, Nani, Masi or Oma.
person.notesHint: Where they learned to cook, what they're known for.
person.photoTooLarge: That photo is too large. Choose one under 10 MB.
person.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this vault? Their details will be hidden from everyone.

members.title: Family members
members.leaveConfirm: Leave {{vault}}? You'll lose access until someone invites you again.
members.lastOwner: A vault needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

invite.title: Invite family
invite.channelLinkHelp: Send it on WhatsApp, by message or any way you like.
invite.channelPhoneHelp: Only someone signing in with this number can use it.
invite.channelEmailHelp: Only someone signing in with this email can use it.
invite.forPerson: Are they already in this vault?
invite.forPersonHelp: Link them to someone you've already added, so their recipes connect to them.
invite.readyBody: Send this link. It works once and expires on {{date}}.
invite.whatsappText: Join our family recipe vault on Virasat: {{url}}

join.title: {{inviter}} invited you to {{vault}}
join.body: Join to see and add your family's recipes. You'll join as: {{role}}.
join.invalidBody: It may have expired, been cancelled or already been used. Ask for a new one.
join.wrongAccount: This invite was sent to a different phone number or email. Sign in with that one, or ask for a new invite.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unitsHelp: How suggested quantities are shown. Your family's own words always stay exactly as they said them.

errors.country: Choose a country from the list.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notAllowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.date: Choose a date that isn't in the future.

capture.sectionIntro: Sit with {{name}} and record them telling it, or photograph a page from their recipe book.
capture.voiceIntro: Press record and let {{name}} tell the recipe in their own words.
capture.pagesIntro: Photograph each page of the handwritten recipe. The original photos are kept exactly as taken.
capture.resumed: Something from earlier is still being sent.
capture.waitingBody: The recording is safe on this device. We will keep trying.
capture.waitingPagesBody: The pages are safe on this device. We will keep trying.
capture.sentBody: {{name}}'s recording is on its way to becoming a recipe. You can follow it in Waiting for you.
capture.sentPagesBody: You can follow it in Waiting for you.
capture.problemNotAllowed: You're signed out, or you can't add recipes here any more. Sign in again, then try again.
capture.problemRejected: We couldn't accept that. Try again, or start over.
capture.pagesHint: One recipe can hold up to {{max}} pages. Add them in order.
capture.tooManyPages: One recipe can hold {{max}} pages. Send these first, then add more.
capture.notAPhoto: {{name}} isn't a photo we can use. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
capture.photoTooLarge: {{name}} is too large. Choose a photo under 20 MB.
capture.cantOpen: We couldn't open {{name}} in this browser. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.

consent.title: Before you record
consent.elderFamily: This recording is for your family. Only people in your family's vault can listen to it.
consent.elderComputer: A computer listens to it and writes your recipe down. The companies that do this don't keep your voice or use it for anything else.
consent.elderKeep: Your voice is kept safely in India. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.
consent.organiserCheckbox: {{name}} knows this recording is for the family, and agrees to it being recorded, written down and kept.
consent.organiserNote: If {{name}} changes their mind, you can delete the recording at any time.
consent.scanNote: A computer reads this page to type up the recipe. The original photo stays in your family vault.
consent.limitReached: That's 10 minutes, the most one recording can hold. Everything you said has been kept.

recordingLinks.title: Recording link
recordingLinks.intro: Send {{name}} a link. They tap it, press one big button and tell the recipe. No app or account needed.
recordingLinks.ready: Your link is ready. Copy it now: for safety it can't be shown again.
recordingLinks.shareText: Please tell me your recipe. Tap this link and press the big button: {{url}}
recordingLinks.stopConfirm: Stop this link? It will stop working right away.

record.waitingBody: Your recording is safe on this phone. We will keep trying.
record.resumed: A recording from earlier is still being sent.
record.sentBody: Your recipe has reached your family.
record.invalidTitle: This link doesn't work any more
record.invalidBody: Please ask your family to send you a new one.
record.micDenied: We couldn't use the microphone. Please allow it in your browser, then try again.
record.unsupported: This browser can't record. Please open the link in Chrome or Safari.

captures.title: Waiting for you
captures.emptyBody: When someone records a recipe, it will appear here.
captures.failed: Couldn't be written up automatically. Open it to type it in.
captures.mockBanner: Test mode: recipes here are made from a fixed sample, not from the recording. No AI service is being used.

review.title: Review
review.intro: A computer wrote this from the original. Check it against the original and fix anything that's wrong. It only becomes a recipe when you save it.
review.toCheck: Parts to check: {{count}}. They are marked “Please check” below.
review.manualHint: Type the recipe in here. Anything that was heard has been put in the first step, to split into ingredients and steps.
review.ingredientsHint: Keep their words exactly as they said them. An amount in numbers is only our suggestion, shown beside their words.
review.suggestedHint: Our guess in numbers. Leave it empty if you're not sure.
review.storyHint: Anything they remembered about the dish: who made it, when.
review.fixErrors: Some parts need your attention. They are marked above.
review.saveNote: Saving keeps this as the original recipe. It is never edited later; a correction is saved as a new version.
review.failedManual: The computer couldn't turn this into a recipe. You can type it in below, using the original beside it.
review.failedTimedOut: This took too long and was stopped. You can type the recipe in below, using the original beside it.
review.failedPipeline: Something went wrong while writing this up. You can type the recipe in below, using the original beside it.
review.pageNotShown: Page {{n}} can't be shown in this browser. It is kept safely in the vault.
review.audioMissing: The recording is no longer in the vault.
review.readFromPage: What was read from the page

errors.originalRequired: Write their words for this ingredient.
errors.invalid: We couldn't save that. Please check the recipe and try again.
errors.form: We couldn't save that. Please check the recipe and try again.
errors.notReady: This was already saved, or isn't ready yet. Reload the page.

add.title: Add to your vault
add.description: What would you like to do?
add.captureHint: Start from the person it comes from.
add.inviteHint: Send a link to join this vault.
add.typeHint: One you know by heart. Takes about two minutes.

firstRecipe.title: Add one recipe you know by heart
firstRecipe.body: Type it the way you'd say it. “A fistful of besan” is perfect. It takes about two minutes.
firstRecipe.ingredientsHint: One per line, in your own words.
firstRecipe.ingredientsPlaceholder:
a fistful of besan
two cups of wheat flour
firstRecipe.skip: Not now, go to my vault
firstRecipe.emptyBody: Type one you know by heart, or record someone who does.

moments.title: Moments
moments.emptyBody: When someone in your family cooks one of these recipes and shares a photo or a note, it shows up here, for your family only.
moments.sheetDescription: Add a photo and a note for your family. Only they will see it.
moments.photoFailed: The note was saved, but the photo didn't upload. Try adding it again.
moments.noRecipes: Add a recipe first. Then you can share a moment when you cook it.
moments.removeConfirm: Remove this moment? The photo is deleted too.

sample.banner: This is an example family. Nothing here is real, and nothing you do changes anything.
sample.intro: Here's what a vault looks like once the recipes are in: the voices, the handwriting, the stories, and who handed what to whom.
sample.audioSoon: The example recording is on its way. In your own vault, you'll hear the real voice here.
sample.ctaTitle: Ready to keep your own family's recipes?
sample.ctaBody: Start with one recipe you know by heart. It takes two minutes.

recipe.audioRemoved: The original recording has been removed. The written recipe stays.
recipe.audioMissing: The recording can't be played right now. Try again in a moment.
recipe.pageNotShown: Page {{n}} can't be shown in this browser. It is kept safely in the vault.
